get.summary: Reads a shape: a snapshot and change log of a collection and filter
get.description:
where is a query v1 filter as JSON (optional; every document without it). offset -1 answers 307 to the first snapshot page snap.<S>.0 of head S, with the shape's handle. Snapshot pages hold at most 1000 documents or 1 MiB in id order (one document may exceed 1 MiB with framing, up to 8 MiB); the last one continues at log position S. A log position O returns the commits after O, at most 4096 of them and 1 MiB, grouped by commit offset; a document that is deleted or stops matching is a delete op, and a delete may name a document the client never received. handle is required unless offset is -1; a stale handle or an offset outside the available history answers 409 must_refetch with the current handle: discard the shape and restart at -1. live=true (log positions only) waits up to 20 seconds for a commit when O is the head, then returns no changes; send the TB-Shape-Cursor of the previous response as cursor; each response advances beyond that cursor, even within one time bucket. Snapshot pages and closed chunks have immutable bytes and stable ETags. Origin responses use private, max-age=0, must-revalidate so every reuse checks current authorization; every response varies on Authorization. Shared CDN caching requires authorization before every cache lookup and is not enabled by these headers. TB-Shape-Handle, TB-Shape-Next-Offset and TB-Shape-Up-To-Date mirror the body; If-None-Match with the ETag returns 304. Treat client state as consistent only when up_to_date is true. At capacity, requests return 429 shape_busy; filters whose canonical continuation URL cannot fit an 8 KiB request line return 414 uri_too_long before redirecting.

Required JWT scopes: shapes:read.

items.description: Most queried first, then collection and shape id in ordinal order.

QueryShapeListBody.description: The bounded observed query shapes of a database or dashboard scope, including pending observations on the primary.

id.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical shape.

shape.description: Canonical query with literal values removed.

totalLatencyMs.description: Sum of observed query latencies in milliseconds.

maxLatencyMs.description: Longest observed query latency in milliseconds.

QueryShapeStats.description: Aggregated observations of one canonical query shape in a collection.

ReplicationBandwidth.description: Replication traffic by source, destination and kind, as observed at the sender and receiver.

ReplicationPoint.description: One replication period bucket, including bytes by traffic kind and directed region pair.

earliest.description: Its oldest snapshot, limited by the plan's retention window.

latest.description: The newest data in the bucket.

RestoreWindow.description: The times a database can be restored to.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last update; `null` before the first.

SavedQuery.description: A named SQL statement saved in a project.

sql.description: A statement of the SQL subset.

SavedQueryRequest.description: A saved query to create or replace.

path.description: Dotted path of object member names.

present.description: Sampled documents that contain the path.

types.description: How many of those hold each JSON type: `string`, `integer`, `number`, `boolean`, `null`, `object` or `array`.

SchemaField.description: One field seen in the sample.

shape_id.description: 32 lowercase hex characters naming the shape.

handle.description: Log lineage; a different one answers `409 must_refetch`.

changes.description: Commits with changes to the shape, in offset order; a snapshot page has exactly one.

ShapeBody.description: A shape snapshot page or log chunk (docs/shape-reads.md).

offset.description: Decimal commit offset; the snapshot head for a snapshot page.

op.description: `upsert` or `delete` (deleted, or no longer matching).

ShapeOpBody.description: One document entering or leaving the shape.

error.description: Why it is not; `null` when Ok.

indexes.description: Names of the indexes the plan reads.

suggestions.description: Fields that would benefit from an index.

SqlCheckBody.description: Whether SQL is in the subset and how the engine would run it.

SqlRequest.description: A body that carries SQL of the dashboard subset.

truncated.description: Whether the limit or the 8 MiB byte bound cut the rows short.

value.description: The whole document for `*`; otherwise one member per selected field, named as written (missing fields are null).

SqlRow.description: One row of a SQL result.

version.description: Service version of the running build.

offset.description: The database commit offset, a decimal string.

results.description: One result per operation, in order.

fields.description: One to four distinct dotted member paths.

normalization.description: String normalization: none, lowercase, or trim_lowercase.

UniqueConstraint.description: A unique scalar or compound key in a collection.

UniqueSchemaField.description: One declared field; only fields marked unique add a constraint.

fields.description: One to four dotted member paths.

UniqueSchemaRequest.description: Unique declarations using the SDK's fields[].unique and indexes[].unique shape.

to.description: End of the last bucket, exclusive.

UsagePeriod.description: Reads and writes over a period.

start.description: Start of the bucket (UTC hour or day).

UsagePoint.description: Reads and writes of one bucket.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the failing document location; empty for the root.

ValidationDetail.description: A schema rule that failed, without the document's values.

version.description: The new version; for a delete, the tombstone's.

offset.description: The database commit offset of the write, a decimal string.
